records.instruction: Pick up the plastic soda bottle using the correct arm
Pick up the plastic soda bottle from the table head-up.
Use the right arm to pick up the hammer with black handle.
Grab the silver hammer head and claw and beat the block.
Open the rectangular laptop with smooth finish carefully using the right arm.
Grab the laptop with glossy black display and open it.
Use the right arm to press the small beige switch with angular sides.
Activate the switch at the red toggle switch
